collect.bio: Marine Tondelier (born 23 August 1986, Bois-Bernard, Pas-de-Calais) is National Secretary of Les Écologistes since December 2022, re-elected in April 2025. She trained at Sciences Po Lille, led the air-quality federation Atmo France (2017-2022), and has sat as an opposition councillor in Hénin-Beaumont since 2014 and as a Hauts-de-France regional councillor since 2021. She announced her 2027 presidential candidacy on 22 October 2025 and was designated by her party on 8 December 2025.

legal.case: Defamation suit by Hénin-Beaumont mayor Steeve Briois and Bruno Bilde (RN) over her 2017 book Nouvelles du Front; she was the defendant

Critics inside the party include Sandrine Rousseau (Feb 2025, 'apparatchik reflexes') and a tribune of more than 500 members (Jan-Feb 2026) against her municipal alliance strategy. verify.bio: Marine Tondelier (born 23 August 1986, Bois-Bernard, Pas-de-Calais) has been National Secretary of Les Écologistes (formerly EELV) since December 2022 and was re-elected in April 2025. She trained at Sciences Po Lille and was délégué générale of the air-quality federation Atmo France (2017-2022). She sat as an opposition councillor in Hénin-Beaumont from 2014 to March 2026, when her list came second (18.22%) behind the incumbent RN mayor, and has been a Hauts-de-France regional councillor since 2021. She announced her 2027 presidential candidacy on 22 October 2025 and was designated by her party on 8 December 2025.

legal.case: Defamation prosecution brought by Hénin-Beaumont mayor Steeve Briois and Bruno Bilde (RN) over her 2017 book 'Nouvelles du Front'; she was the defendant. The Paris tribunal correctionnel found some statements defamatory but acquitted (relaxe) her on grounds of good faith. No appeal was found in the sources consulted.
legal.date: Judgment reported by France Bleu on 6 November 2020 (Paris tribunal correctionnel); exact judgment day not confirmed

reversals.before: On 18 November 2024 she called X a 'catalyst of hate' and argued for regulating or closing it. On 12 January 2025 she urged the left to leave the platform.
reversals.after: On 19 January 2025 she said no collective departure had happened and that she would stay on X to defend ecology on 'hostile terrain'.

delivery.what: Led the party as National Secretary and was re-elected in the first round with 72.64% on 19 April 2025. She has never held national or local executive office, so she has no ministerial or executive record.
delivery.assessment: Her record is party management only. Critics inside the party include Sandrine Rousseau, who in September 2025 accused her circle of 'apparatchik reflexes' (l'Opinion, 17 Sep 2025; Challenges, 20 Sep 2025), and a tribune of more than 500 members (January 2026) against her municipal alliance strategy, after which the party suspended signatories who did not withdraw. This comes from one secondary source (Wikipedia) and was not corroborated directly.
